School Floor Marks Shoes 027

After practice, the hall floor had dark marks. A notice already asked for clean indoor shoes. One pupil thought someone must have ignored it. The coach checked the shoes used that day. A pair kept only indoors had a damaged sole that left marks even though it was clean. The team cleaned the floor with the caretaker’s help and labelled that pair for replacement. The coach kept the clean-shoe rule, but added a quick sole check. She did not accuse everyone who had walked near a mark. The visible mark showed a problem, not the identity or intention of the person who caused it.
